description_en: Queries abnormal cloud resources added in cloud native mode
description_zh: 查询异常的云产品接入资源
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-abnormal-cloud-resources --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAbnormalCloudResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of your WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: a region outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

AbnormalCloudResources.description_en: The abnormal cloud resources that are added in cloud native mode
AbnormalCloudResources.description_zh: 异常状态的云产品接入信息

items.description_en: A cloud resource that is in an abnormal state
items.description_zh: 异常状态的云产品接入信息

CloudResourceId.description_en: The ID of the cloud resource. This ID is automatically generated by WAF when the resource is added
CloudResourceId.description_zh: 接入的资源ID，由WAF自动生成

AppliedType.description_en:
The type of the certificate for the HTTPS protocol. Valid values:

default: default certificate.

extension: additional certificate
AppliedType.description_zh:
HTTPS协议的证书类型。取值：

default：表示默认证书。

extension：表示拓展证书

CertName.description_en: The name of the certificate in SSL Certificate Service
CertName.description_zh: 数字证书管理服务的证书名称

Code.description_en:
The cause of the exception. Valid values:

InvalidCert: The certificate is invalid.

ClientCertOpend: Mutual authentication is enabled.

NetworkConfigLost: A network error occurred.

UserUploadCert: A custom certificate is uploaded.

CertNotExistInCertCenter: The certificate ID does not exist in SSL Certificate Service.

CertExpired: The certificate has expired.

EmptyCertCN: The common name (CN) is empty
Code.description_zh:
异常原因，取值：

InvalidCert：表示无效证书。

ClientCertOpend：表示开启了双向认证。

NetworkConfigLost：表示网络异常。

UserUploadCert：表示存在用户上传的证书。

CertNotExistInCertCenter：表示证书ID在数字证书管理服务不存在。

CertExpired：表示证书过期。

EmptyCertCN：表示CommonName空

CommonName.description_en: The common name (CN) of the certificate

ExpireTime.description_en: The time when the certificate expires. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
ExpireTime.description_zh: 证书的到期时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

ProductCertId.description_en: The ID of the certificate that is configured in the cloud service console
ProductCertId.description_zh: 在云产品控制台配置的证书ID

ProductCertName.description_en: The name of the certificate that is configured in the cloud service console
ProductCertName.description_zh: 在云产品控制台配置证书的证书名称

ProductDomainExtension.description_en: The additional domain name that is configured in the cloud service console
ProductDomainExtension.description_zh: 云产品控制台配置的扩展域名

Reason.description_en:
The cause of the exception. Valid values:

InvalidCert: The certificate is invalid.

ClientCertOpend: Mutual authentication is enabled.

NetworkConfigLost: A network error occurred.

UserUploadCert: A custom certificate is uploaded.

CertNotExistInCertCenter: The certificate ID does not exist in SSL Certificate Service.

CertExpired: The certificate has expired.

EmptyCertCN: The common name (CN) is empty
Reason.description_zh:
异常原因，取值：

EmptyCertCN：表示CommonName空

ResourceInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance that is added to WAF

ResourceInstanceName.description_en: The name of the instance that is added to WAF

ResourceInstancePort.description_en: The port of the instance that is added to WAF

ResourceProduct.description_en:
The cloud service to which the resource belongs. By default, instances of Application Load Balancer (ALB), MSE, FC, and SAE are returned. Valid values:

alb: ALB.

mse: MSE.

fc: FC.

sae: SAE.

ecs: ECS.

clb4: Classic Load Balancer (CLB) that uses TCP.

clb7: CLB that uses HTTP or HTTPS.

nlb: Network Load Balancer (NLB).

Each cloud service is supported in different regions. If you specify this parameter, make sure that the specified cloud service is supported in the selected region. Otherwise, the request may fail
ResourceProduct.description_zh:
资源所属云产品，默认返回ALB、MSE、FC和SAE产品的实例，取值：

alb：表示ALB产品。

mse：表示MSE产品。

fc：表示FC产品。

sae：表示SAE产品。

ecs：表示ECS产品。
clb4：表示CLB(TCP)产品。
clb7：表示CLB(HTTP/HTTPS)产品。
nlb：表示NLB产品。

每个产品支持的地域不同，产品筛选字段有值时，需要参考地域支持的产品，否则可能导致筛选失败
